approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: The current exact-reference patterns consume the remainder of a line, so a second RFI or Submittal marker on that line is never scanned.
Offline examples lose RFI 43, Submittal 23-02 and the final RFI in a mixed RFI/Submittal line.
Reuse the existing patterns, digit-bearing normalizer and deduplication; continue searching after each marker start instead of adding semantic parsing.
No fuzzy matching, relationship inference, mailbox access or model call is permitted.
633 Python, 24 UI and 11 deployment-boundary tests passed offline; parser and API regressions retain two same-line RFIs plus a same-line Submittal with zero model calls.
title: Preserve multiple workflow references per line
objective: Retain every distinct exact RFI and Submittal reference on one source line without weakening identifier validation or inferring relationships.
